answer: A sybil farm hides like water beneath a dune, yet it cannot hide heat. Bind every live seat to continuous proof-of-energy: each identity must answer a fresh memory-hard beacon every interval under a tight deadline, metering sustained power draw, not a one-shot entry fee. A single host has a fixed thermal budget, its ivory spec-sheet a hard ceiling, so only so many seats can keep answering before deadlines slip and bonds burn. The nectar of a thousand free keypairs sours: each standing clone now costs recurring electricity and hardware, and the farm's own furnace betrays its true count.
